target: High-budget full-frame collision well below 33 ms, ideally below 16 ms
status: No prototype retained. Exploratory performance screen, not correctness acceptance. All runtime source restored to baseCommit.
protocol: Sequential bounded 4314-body, 90-frame, 16+4 runs, 50 ms idle/frame. Six timed frames after 30-frame warmup. Compare split-pass runs only against split control; normal runs only against normal control. Single run per variant, not interleaved statistical trials. Prototypes changed floating-point paths/contact histories; none underwent full settling acceptance because none showed a useful speedup.

simplex.description: Fixed-local simplex instead of indexed four-element arrays

measurement.protocol: Diagnostic per-dispatch pass splitting; collision sums dispatch timestamps, GPU total unavailable. Not comparable to unsplit totals. Reconstructed deterministic lattice (paper layout unavailable); reference collision params except NM, tolerance .01 and maxIterations 50; 16ms frames; released AVBD substeps/iterations. GPU collision timestamps sum all substeps on every tenth measured frame; include prepare, spatial broadphase, search and export. Wall timings include per-substep counter readback and timed-frame timestamp waits. Idle excluded. Single run per budget, not hardware-equivalent paper t_coll.
